title: xebench benchmarks
description: Canonical cross-engine on-device LLM benchmark results published by xebench. This file is the stable contract for consumers (e.g. the pocketpal.dev leaderboard loads it dynamically). Contract 1.1 is additive over 1.0: every 1.0 file still validates. Additive changes bump the minor and breaking changes bump the major; consumers must reject a major they do not support. Rows are closed (additionalProperties false), so a consumer validating with this schema must be updated before a producer publishes a new minor's fields. Invariants this schema cannot express (dispersion min <= max, a real calendar generatedAt) are enforced by scripts/lib/publication.mjs.

schemaVersion.description: MAJOR.MINOR of this contract ("1.0" or "1.1"); a different major is unsupported and must be rejected as a whole

generatedAt.description: UTC time the file was last regenerated: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ since 1.1; the date-only YYYY-MM-DD form of 1.0 remains valid

device.description: marketing device name, e.g. 'POCO F8 Ultra'

quant.description: quantization scheme, e.g. 'Q4_0', 'W4A16'; ALWAYS surfaced, never hidden

ppTps.description: prefill tokens/sec (null if the source didn't report it); on measured rows the median of sampleCount successful repetitions

tgTps.description: decode tokens/sec (null if not reported); on measured rows the median of sampleCount successful repetitions

provenance.description: who supplied the number: measured = xebench lab run; vendor = engine-maker official published number; community = third-party enthusiast benchmark. Provenance is not validation.

sampleCount.description: n successful repetitions behind the medians

asStated.description: human-readable methodology caveats for this row (quant, provenance method, protocol)

validation.description: 1.1, measured rows only. legacy = published before protocol/evidence validation existed; unverified = conditions not verified; failed = a validation or run-condition check failed; verified = guards passed and evidence is linked

guardsPassed.description: 1.1, measured rows only. Run-condition guard outcome: true = passed, false = a condition failed (validation must be failed), null = not verified

conditionPolicy.description: 1.1, measured rows only. Run-condition policy id, e.g. 'observed-conditions-v1'

protocolVersion.description: 1.1, measured rows only. Measurement protocol id, e.g. 'cpu-reference-v1'

timingMethod.description: 1.1, measured rows only. How ppTps/tgTps were timed, e.g. 'engine-timings'

dispersion.description: 1.1, measured rows only; not on legacy rows. Spread of the successful repetitions behind ppTps/tgTps

evidence.description: 1.1, measured rows only; required when verified, absent on legacy rows. Immutable sanitized evidence behind the row

bundleSha256.description: lowercase hex SHA-256 of the evidence bundle

url.description: https URL of the immutable evidence bundle: a host (no credentials), printable ASCII only

build.description: 1.1, measured rows only. Identity of the software that produced the row

allOf.$comment: 1.1 fields are valid on provenance=measured rows only
verified requires guardsPassed === true and evidence
legacy rows carry no dispersion or evidence; a measured row without validation (1.0) is legacy

spread.description: finite non-negative tokens/sec; min <= max (enforced by scripts/lib/publication.mjs)
